title: My Son Forged A Dissolution And Sold My Solar Stake. So I Let The Agreement Undo His Sale.
description: When I cashed out my $131,000 401(k) to become a partner in my son's solar business, he forged a dissolution, sold the contracts for $790,000, and mailed me a $4,800 utility credit. I retrieved our original partnership agreement sealed inside a discarded inverter, voided the sale, and now he cleans panels in a vest labeled 'Short-Circuited Trust' while every installation manual prints his fraud docket number. #WattOfDeceitSolar #ShortCircuitedTrust #BetrayalStory
thumb_text: HE CLEANS MY PANELS IN A VEST THAT SAYS 'SHORT-CIRCUITED TRUST'
pinned_comment: If you invested your entire $131K 401(k) into your son's solar company and he later forged a sale behind your back, leaving you with a $4,800 credit, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: HE SENT ME A $4,800 CREDIT AND TRASHED THE INVERTER
